apiDocs.title: API Documentation
apiDocs.subtitle: Comprehensive API endpoints and integration guides for 1POS. All API endpoints require authentication via JWT token in the Authorization header or auth-token cookie.
apiDocs.responseFormatDesc: All API responses follow a standard JSON format with success status and data or error information.

apiDocs.subtitleShort: The endpoints behind this register, for your own scripts and integrations.
apiDocs.descLogin: Sign in with email, password and store slug; sets the auth-token cookie

apiDocs.descLogout: Sign out and revoke the token
apiDocs.descProductsPatch: Change some fields of a product

apiDocs.descInventoryLowStock: Products at or below their low-stock level
apiDocs.descInventoryRealtime: Live stock changes as a server-sent event stream
apiDocs.authIntro: There are no separate API keys. Every call runs as a signed-in user: signing in sets an httpOnly auth-token cookie, and each request only sees this store’s data, within that user’s role and permissions.
apiDocs.authNote: Sign-in is protected by a bot check, so scripts work best with the session of a browser that is already signed in.
apiDocs.baseUrlDescStore: The store comes from the signed-in user, so the address is the same for every store on this site.

apiDocs.openApiNote: Covers sign-in, products, transactions, subscriptions and health so far.
